resolved_decisions.question: BG1300's tests and mutants must run as HOME=$(mktemp -d) python3 -m pytest, and the worktree HOME guard refuses that form in every builder worktree; the settings.local.json allow rule does not reach the guard. How should BG1300 be proved?

options.label: Exempt the form
options.consequence: operator exempts exactly HOME=$(mktemp -d) python3 -m pytest from the worktree guard; a builder then finishes BG1300 in this run

options.label: Operator runs the tests
options.consequence: operator runs the lane's tests and mutants from the main tree with the ! prefix; the builder writes the rest from that output

options.label: Descope again
options.consequence: BG1300 leaves the batch for a later run with the staged fix kept in its worktree; 2 points fewer

recommend.label: Exempt the form
recommend.reason: the operator already approved this exact form for this unit (D0454); exempting it at the guard is the narrow change that lets the normal lane run

resolution.note: Operator chose this on 2026-11-12. Claude Code's documentation says the worktree command-shape check cannot be turned off, so the operator then ruled that BG1300's builder run without worktree isolation in the main checkout, last, with other commits held; it was built there (a9596961) and Fixed on qa-seat-BG1300-r1's APPROVE.

sprint_goal_verdict.note: All 18 units delivered on independent APPROVEs (57 points): every EP0280 story binds a recorded verdict to the file its brief issued, names the agent that wrote it and records an editing context as a self-review; EP0276 cites the committed run record, names the plan by digest, freezes prices and the lane-yield tally. Reopened once (D0468) to fix BG1374, the report twin's bare price-source URL. US0999 was deferred to run eleven (D0465), and this run's own record still names its plan by the .local path because it opened before US0998.
